name: Beehive Internet
summary: Sydney dialup/web-host ISP (Breakfast Bytes Pty Limited, domains beehive.inoz.com / beehive.inoz.au; shareholder Suzanne Todd, related to Adam Todd's AHNet); static homepage persisted to ~2004.

events.details: Breakfast Bytes Pty Ltd (ACN 081 726 669); homepage 'Created 17/09/98', so existed by Sep 1998.
Static homepage (©1999 Breakfast Bytes) persisted on beehive.inoz.com to last capture 5 May 2004; content long frozen, so the operating ISP likely wound down earlier.
